full_judgment: 63. Now let us address the vires of Rule 4(2) of the Promotion Rules of 2002. It is wellsettled that there is a presumption of constitutionality in favour of the impugned provisions of Rule 4(2) of the Promotion Rules of 2002. Of course, that presumption is a rebuttable presumption.
